look: Storm Elemental, a C-rank GKOM variant from the Static Sprites family: whirling storm-cloud body stitched with crystal lightning. Family anatomy: crackling spark sprites and storm spirits stitched with lightning. Build: compact and agile. GKOM rank cue: GKOM crystal plates over shoulders, back and limbs; about a third of the body crystallised; the crystals are electric-yellow static crystal. A fist-sized GKOM core orb, deep red with internal light, is embedded visibly in its chest or body centre. Element Lightning: electric yellow, cyan and indigo accents, clear branching arcs, static sparks and crackling halos
